authority.faraday: Canonical scientific workflow, domain validation, evidence admission, and conclusion ceilings.
authority.metamaps: Derived versioned graph projections and validation findings only.
authority.deep_research: Cited read-only source discovery and review-only proposals only.
authority.human_review: Hypothesis activation, protected protocol approval, and substantive scientific acceptance.
authority.external_execution: No authority unless separately granted and returned through Faraday receipts.

completion_rule: Every required gate is accepted with current artifact-bound evidence; dependency changes invalidate dependent acceptance.

gates.title: Candidate theory portfolio
missing: Approved runtime binding to canonical hypothesis state
Application-service cross-record validation and scientific sealing
Fresh fixture and compatibility verification
acceptance_evidence: Schema and service validation for complete candidate records
Adverse fixtures for missing limits, competitors, and validity regimes
Authoritative-read replay of candidate commitments
gates.authority_boundary: A complete candidate remains unreviewed until human activation.

gates.title: Mathematical obligation registry
missing: Approved runtime binding to frozen candidate obligations
Application-service witness, control, and current-byte replay
Fresh pass, fail, inconclusive, and not-applicable verification
acceptance_evidence: Obligation coverage for each accepted fixture candidate
Artifact-bound pass, fail, inconclusive, and not-applicable findings
Change-impact revalidation when an assumption changes
gates.authority_boundary: A passed obligation is bounded checker evidence, not proof of a physical theory.

gates.title: Protected notebook composition and execution
missing: Provider-neutral obligation-to-notebook draft contract
Notebook result schema for obligation findings
QM-relativity benchmark and adverse fixtures
acceptance_evidence: Reviewed draft-to-freeze workflow
Clean source and dependency replay
Partial-failure receipt preservation
No hidden dependency fixture
gates.authority_boundary: Notebook composition is review-only and notebook execution is not theorem proof.

gates.title: Formal and independent computation verification
missing: Proof-assistant or independently checkable formal-artifact adapter
Checker trust and version receipt
Shared conceptual-error review gate
acceptance_evidence: Two complete route bundles with exact sharing declarations
Hidden shared-helper rejection
Independent checker replay
Disagreement retained as a scientific outcome
gates.authority_boundary: Code separation and checker success do not establish physical correctness.

gates.title: Theory-to-observation transformation chain
missing: Theory-observable transformation contract
Propagation and detector-response stages
Uncertainty propagation and applicability replay
acceptance_evidence: Exact end-to-end transformation inventory
Unit, sign, coordinate, timing, and preprocessing adverse fixtures
Recomputed detector-level prediction from frozen theory inputs
gates.authority_boundary: A complete transformation chain establishes provenance, not measurement validity or theory truth.

gates.title: Empirical source and custody adapters
missing: Selected public empirical channel
Domain source adapter and source-specific failure fixtures
Calibration, covariance, timing, and systematic-error contracts for that channel
acceptance_evidence: Registered immutable raw bytes
Current custody replay
Independent source and calibration review
Synthetic campaign pass before live data use
gates.authority_boundary: Source access and byte integrity do not establish source truth or scientific adequacy.

gates.title: Prospective prediction and distinguishability adjudication
missing: Parameterized theory prediction contract
Detector-level uncertainty and nuisance model
First-class not-distinguishable adjudication
acceptance_evidence: Frozen prediction before protected observation exposure
Signal, null, adverse, and insufficient-resolution fixtures
Exact result-selector and claim-ceiling replay
gates.authority_boundary: An adjudication compares registered predictions within scope; it does not confirm a universal theory.

gates.title: Counterfactual and systemic implication engine
missing: Versioned counterfactual query and result contracts
Separation of logical implication from causal intervention
Bounded propagation and uncertainty semantics
acceptance_evidence: Baseline/intervention replay
Impossible or out-of-regime query rejection
Affected prediction and revalidation set
Counterfactual result retained as derived non-evidence
gates.authority_boundary: Counterfactual propagation is conditional on its model and assumptions.

gates.title: Versioned Metamaps projection
missing: Accepted shared record-reference contract
Authorized pinned Metamaps compiler and API
Faraday adapter, shadow comparison, invalidation, and rollback evidence
acceptance_evidence: Projection binds exact record and compiler versions
Changed input invalidates every dependent projection
Shadow output comparison against canonical Faraday state
Graph disagreement leaves Faraday authoritative
gates.authority_boundary: Metamaps produces projections and findings only; graph edges are not evidence or approval.

gates.title: Read-only deep-research bridge
missing: Read-only MCP or equivalent context interface
Reconciliation-specific frozen context projection
Citation-complete proposal and notebook-source return contract
acceptance_evidence: Context snapshot and proposal bind the same digest
Filesystem, secret, execution, and canonical-write denial tests
Human adjudication before any canonical scientific transition
gates.authority_boundary: Deep research may propose and cite; it cannot activate, execute, clear gates, admit evidence, or authorize effects.

gates.title: Controlled reconciliation acceptance campaign
missing: Separate experiment repository and controlled candidates
Executable acceptance harness
Independent replay and review
acceptance_evidence: At least two complete hypothesis iterations
Every planted defect rejected at its intended boundary
Negative and inconclusive outcomes preserved
Insufficient-resolution case returns not-distinguishable
Workspace audit and ledger verification pass
Portable package independently reproduced
gates.authority_boundary: Campaign acceptance establishes process capability, not a true reconciliation theory.

gates.title: Current runtime and regression baseline
missing: Fresh full-suite result on supported Python versions
Pinned or otherwise reproducible verification environment
Continuous regression evidence
acceptance_evidence: Fresh full test suite and compile check
Ledger verification for representative workspaces
Documented environment and exact revision
No unresolved required checks
gates.authority_boundary: A green suite establishes implementation consistency only.
